title: Coupled channels, fast diffusion: U in the channel plane
caption: U at z = 0 at the three recorded times with the most open channels, per solver; channels closed (blue) or open (green).
simulations: One trial (seed 1) of Test 2 per solver, Δt = 0.0002 s, recorded every 0.05 s to 3 s into results bundles (sims/render_3d.py). Native channel states come from VCell's per-node counts (exact: channels sit on nodes).
interpretation: With D = 1000 µm²/s calcium from an open channel spreads over the slab within milliseconds, so U is almost uniform (spread < 0.2 µM at ~10 µM): the well-mixed limit, where the hybrid is compared with the exact piecewise-deterministic process. Opening speeds up with U, so openings run away into bursts in which most channels are open at once. The two trials are independent samples; their distributions agree (see the Fig 2 comparison).
